title: Stop Handcrafting Your Engine! GenDB-V: Towards AI-Generated and Formally Verified Database Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.02779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For over 50 years, the database community has developed a wide range of successful engines to answer two fundamental questions: how can database systems run faster, and how can we ensure their correctness? Experience with these engines shows that performance depends on hardware and workloads. As both change over time, we repeatedly redesign and rebuild database systems, a time-consuming and expensive process. Correctness remains another long-standing challenge: recent studies continue to uncover wrong-answer bugs even in mature database engines, despite years of development and testing. To address these, we present GenDB-V, a system that enables AI agents to synthesize database engines specialized to hardware and workloads for performance, and formally verified for correctness. translated_abstract: 五十多年来，数据库社区开发了多种成功的引擎来回答两个根本问题：如何让数据库系统运行得更快，以及如何确保其正确性？这些引擎的经验表明，性能取决于硬件和工作负载。随着两者随时间不断变化，我们不得不反复重新设计和重建数据库系统，这是一个耗时且代价高昂的过程。正确性则是另一个长期存在的挑战：尽管经历了多年的开发和测试，最近的研究仍在成熟的数据库引擎中不断发现错误结果类缺陷。为解决这些问题，我们提出了GenDB-V，一个使AI智能体能够自动合成数据库引擎的系统，这些引擎针对特定硬件和工作负载进行专门化以获得性能，并经过形式化验证以保证正确性。GenDB-V支持SQL模板的专门化实现，以及接受所支持SQL子集中任意查询的通用引擎。首先，我们开发
tldr: GenDB-V提出利用AI智能体自动生成针对特定硬件和工作负载优化、并经形式化验证保证正确性的数据库引擎，以解决数据库系统手工开发成本高昂和正确性难以保障的两大长期难题。
en_tdlr: GenDB-V enables AI agents to automatically synthesize database engines specialized for specific hardware and workloads and formally verified for correctness, addressing the long-standing challenges of costly manual engine development and correctness assurance in database systems.
